reason: A DeepSeek Harness web-interface plugin that adds in-place prompt editing, answer regeneration, conversation version paging, tree forking, sidebar organization, and session deletion; the README states that two host source patches are required for full functionality.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供原位编辑提问、重新生成回复、对话版本翻页、整棵对话树分支及会话管理功能。
summaries.en: Adds in-place prompt editing, answer regeneration, conversation version paging, whole-tree branching, and session management to the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Edits user messages and resends them
Regenerates assistant replies through session forks
Copies conversation trees into independent sessions
Deletes conversation sessions and their on-disk logs
Applies source patches to the host application
